editorial.blurb: CheSa's Bistro & Bar celebrates Southern and soul food with meticulous attention to gluten-free dining, where crispy fried catfish, jambalaya, and beignet waffles shine in a thoughtfully designed modern space.
editorial.insiderTip: Call ahead if you have multiple dietary restrictions (gluten-free, dairy-free, etc.) — the kitchen is genuinely accommodating and will work with you, plus ask about off-menu items like the Beignet Waffles with Peaches.
signatureDishes: Beignet Waffles with Peaches and Ice Cream
